written_before_tuning: This file, with the margin and every rule below, was committed before any tuning code or tuning run existed.
improvement_margin_meaning: A model ships only if its CV MAPE is at least this many percentage points below the baseline's. If none is, the baseline ships and the report says so.
tie_rule: Every contender within tie_band_mape_pp of the best CV MAPE is tied. The tie goes to the simplest, in simplicity_order. The ensemble only wins by beating the best single model by more than the tie band.
shortlist_rule: The three best default models by CV MAPE in the benchmark: CatBoost 26.31, HistGradientBoosting 26.78, MLP 27.18.
search: Random search, one seeded draw per trial, every trial scored on the same five development folds as the benchmark. No other data is read.

ensemble_mean.what: Equal-weight average of the three tuned models' predictions in log-price, using their out-of-fold predictions. No weights are learned.
ensemble_mean.plan_change: The valuation plan lists seven single models. The ensemble is an addition agreed on 19 Oct 2026.
